comments.text:
Implement MixerPage Vizia view: the main mixer surface with all 16 part strips, master, ext, FX, and comp+EQ.

DEPENDS ON: i7-49c.1 (ParamRegistry), i7-49c.12 (ChannelStrip)

LAYOUT (horizontal scrollable):
- 16 ChannelStrip (part variant) side by side
- 1 ChannelStrip (ext variant) 
- 2 FxStrip (Chorus + Reverb) — need to implement FxStrip too
- 6 ChannelStrip (comp-eq variant, conditional on drumCompEq.enabled + eqExpanded)
- 1 ChannelStrip (master variant)

CONTROLS ABOVE MIXER:
- TopBar with studio set selector + tone info (can be stub initially)
- PartSelector (16 numbered buttons to select active part)
- Details toggle button (expand/collapse EQ sections)

STATE BINDING:
- Read MixerState from shared DeviceState
- Call DeviceState setters on user interaction
- Consume ParamRegistry for parameter metadata

REFERENCE:
- web/src/MixerPage.tsx: full React implementation
- web/src/FxStrip.tsx: FX strip with type selector, output routing, parameter knobs

Place in crates/integral-vst/src/views/.

title: VST/Vizia: implement MixerPage with 16 parts, master, ext, FX strips
